title: Even at half off its a rip off
text: Did a Groupon and basically got half off. What I received was candy I've seen you can buy hereon Amazon and elsewhere super cheap. Even though I got half off, I still did not feel it was even close to being worth it. The portions are extremely small. Additionally, I selected the "sweet" option and got almost entirely sour and not a single piece of chocolate.
label: negative
